name: How long does a roof penetration assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof penetration assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof penetration assessment varies depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the number of penetrations. For a standard residential roof, it typically takes 1 to 2 hours. Larger commercial properties or roofs with extensive penetrations may require more time. We aim to complete the assessment efficiently while ensuring thoroughness.
acceptedAnswer.description: The assessment usually takes 1-2 hours for a standard residential roof, varying with roof size and penetration count.
